logo_override.validation_detail: png, probed HTTP 200 with content-type image/png (3042 bytes). Rendered on a white background and visually confirmed as Yale University's official wordmark - the distinctive black 'Yale' in Yale's proprietary typeface, black on a white/transparent field with no white-on-transparent wordmark. The asset filename is logo-print.png, i.e. the positive variant intended for light backgrounds, rather than the reversed white version used on Yale's dark header band.
logo_override._award: Global Health Emerging Scholars (GHES) Fellowship - 2027-28 fellowship year

notes: Rule 2 check first, since this record has a multi-body awarding structure: GHES is run by the Yale Institute for Global Health at Yale School of Medicine with Stanford, University of Arizona and UC Berkeley, and is sponsored by the NIH Fogarty International Center under LAUNCH. Yale is one of the four institutions that award the fellowship and is the lead institution, so Yale's mark belongs on this record. Note for the merge: the NIH/LAUNCH sponsorship means this record arguably has two identities, and if the catalogue prefers to credit the funder, the Fogarty mark on a .nih.gov host would be the alternative - I did not go looking for one because the shard host and the record's official_source both point at Yale. The GHES programme itself publishes no separate logo file, and the Yale Institute for Global Health site returned an empty image set, so a Yale mark is the correct fallback rather than a guess. Discovery path: the GHES application-process page at medicine.yale.edu carries no img logo at all (its header is an inline SVG, unusable under rule 5) and only icon links under cdn1.medicine.yale.edu/icons/ysm/. Following brief section 2.3 to the university brand page, https://www.yale.edu/ header markup names exactly one logo file, sites/all/themes/yale_blue/images/logo-print.png, which is what I probed and rendered. Rejected: cdn1.medicine.yale.edu/icons/ysm/apple-touch-icon.png (200 but 180x180, 0% transparent, 63.9% near-white, mean rgb(182,194,209) - a pale washed-out tile) and .../favicon-32x32.png (32x32, mean rgb(94,121,153)). Probed and 404: medicine.yale.edu/images/logo.png, /yigh/images/logo.png, /content/dam/ysm/images/logo.png, www.yale.edu/sites/default/files/inline-images/Yale-Logo.svg, /sites/default/files/Yale_Logo.svg, /themes/custom/yalebase/logo.svg, /logo.svg, /apple-touch-icon.png. Host evidence: www.yale.edu is the parent domain of the shard host medicine.yale.edu, which rule 1 permits explicitly, and it shares the registrable domain yale.edu.
